text.title: Go Error Handling Patterns (Wrap, Translate, Sentinel, Log-Once) Output Contract
text.summary: Pins the shape of a valid Go Error Handling Patterns (Wrap, Translate, Sentinel, Log-Once) output. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the actual answer / chosen option / value produced
at least 2 sentences; cites at least one input artefact by name
list of input names with source paths or URLs

forbidden.pattern: rationale that does not reference any input by name
inputs_used empty AND decision is not 'no-op'
duplicate artefact_id within the same store

allowed-transformations.transformation: Trim rationale to no more than 500 chars, preserving numeric claims and named tools.
Promote 'no decision yet' to status='pending' rather than fabricating a decision.
Group near-duplicate inputs, recording the group with member count.

section.title: Code-shape contract (what the artefact describes)
section.p: The artefact above records the DECISION. This section pins the measurable shape of the error module that decision produces — every bound here is a hard zero or a hard one.

example.note: apperror_package too short, sentinel_count below minimum, unwrapped_boundaries and type_assertion_count above zero (both are hard zeros), edge_translator_count above its maximum of one.

list.item: `errors.New("prefix: " + err.Error())` instead of `fmt.Errorf("prefix: %w", err)` — the chain is lost.
`panic` used to signal a domain error (not-found, conflict, validation).
Two or more places translating domain errors to HTTP status codes.
Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output
Exactly one apperror package holds the canonical sentinel set
Zero unwrapped layer boundaries; zero type assertions on errors
Exactly one edge translator; zero control-flow panics
